# the docs also list .claude/.agents compatibility roots, which the adapter does not write (of
# the candidate roots the opencode-named ones are the documented first locations, and writing
# .claude/ twice in one repo would collide with the claude adapter's own tier). Context:
# AGENTS.md in the project root (opencode.ai/docs/rules) - goblin-stack's hermes adapter
# deliberately leaves the project's AGENTS.md user-owned (the INTEGRATION position: bootstrap
# is read-one-file), so the opencode adapter manages the SAME file mechanism per platform and
# names it here; the block is merge-not-clobber, bytes outside it untouched. Capabilities:
# permission config can deny tool actions including skill loading (docs/permissions) but there
# is no marketplace channel in the docs; no post-compaction hook is documented.
